market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely range-bound with elevated volatility. August CPI release is the dominant catalyst—bullish if <3.0%, bearish if >3.3%. Oil near $95 caps upside for rate-sensitive sectors. Geopolitical headlines (Iran, Ukraine) create whipsaw risk. Expect 2-3% two-way moves around CPI print.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle remains intact with Nvidia-Hugging Face and Snowflake validating demand. Energy transition (EVs at 25% in Australia, bulk power emergency) provides structural tailwinds. Labor softening may force Fed to cut by Q1 2027. Geopolitical fragmentation (gold relocation, trade gaps) supports defensive positioning. Consumer staples face 12-month margin pressure from input costs.
